settings.heading: How can we help?
settings.text: Search our most common questions, or browse by topic.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive within 2–3 weeks. Larger or heavier orders can take a little longer.

settings.question: Is shipping free?
settings.answer: Yes. Shipping is free on every order, with no minimum spend, and every order is tracked.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose your country at the top of the page to see prices in your currency.

settings.question: When will I get my tracking number?
settings.answer: When your order ships we email your tracking number. It can take up to 48 hours to show updates. Track your order

settings.question: Do I pay customs or import tax?
settings.answer: Any customs duties or taxes charged by your country are paid by the customer.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: PayPal, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay and major cards. Checkout is encrypted.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Email support@luxedealers.com as soon as possible with your order number and we'll do our best to help.

settings.question: Do you have any discounts?
settings.answer:
Yes. Buy any 2 items and save 10%, or buy 3 or more and save 15%. You can mix any items, and the saving applies automatically at checkout, so there's no code to enter.

Join our email list for 10% off your first order. Your personal code appears straight away and we email it to you too. Codes are single use and can't be combined with other discounts.

settings.question: Are your items true to size?
settings.answer: Most clothing and shoes follow Asian sizing, so we recommend sizing up. See the size charts, or email us and we'll help.

settings.question: Are items checked before they ship?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order is hand-checked before it's packed.

settings.question: Is checkout secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Checkout runs on Shopify's encrypted checkout, and you can pay with PayPal, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay or a card.

settings.question: Where can I find the size guide?
settings.answer: Every product with sizes has a Size guide link next to the size options. You can also see all our size charts in one place.

settings.question: What if something is wrong with my order?
settings.answer: We'll make it right with a refund or a free replacement. Email support@luxedealers.com with your order number and a photo of the problem.

settings.question: Do I need to send the item back?
settings.answer: No. If an item arrives damaged, faulty, wrong or missing, there's no need to send anything back.

settings.question: What if my parcel doesn't arrive?
settings.answer: Email us with your order number. Our refund or reship guarantee covers parcels that don't arrive.

settings.question: How long does a refund take?
settings.answer: Refunds go back to your original payment method. Your bank may take 5 to 10 business days to show it. Refund policy
